css: .kfs-print table td, .kfs-print table th { padding: 4px 6px; vertical-align: top; }
html:

{% if not doc.kfs_valid_till %}
Key Facts Statement not available
This Loan Application does not have a Key Facts Statement yet. Save the Loan Application with the Loan Amount, Rate of Interest and Repayment Periods filled in to generate it.
{% else %} {% set currency = frappe.db.get_value("Company", doc.company, "default_currency") %} {% macro money(v) %}{{ frappe.utils.fmt_money(v, currency=currency) }}{% endmacro %}
Proposal / Account No.: {{ doc.unique_proposal_number or "" }}
Date: {{ frappe.utils.formatdate(doc.posting_date) }}
Valid Till: {{ frappe.utils.formatdate(doc.kfs_valid_till) if doc.kfs_valid_till else "-" }}
Part 1 — Interest Rate and Fees / Charges
1. Loan proposal / account number{{ doc.unique_proposal_number or "" }}
2. Type of loan{{ doc.loan_type or "" }}

8. Details of contingent chargesPenal / foreclosure / bounce charges as per the sanction terms of the loan product

Nodal grievance redressal officer (phone / email){{ doc.nodal_officer_phone or "-" }} {% if doc.nodal_officer_email %}/ {{ doc.nodal_officer_email }}{% endif %}
Whether the loan may be transferred / securitisedAs per the terms of the loan agreement
Annex C — Repayment Schedule
